svg.text: Step 1: cut the record into short windows (2.56 s each, a new one every 0.64 s)
Step 2: find the notes in each window (its spectrum, turned on its side)
Each bar is one frequency: its length and its colour both show how strong that note is in the window.
Step 3: colour each spectrum in and stand them side by side
Colour: how strong each note is.
